name: Fibrous Dysplasia / McCune-Albright Syndrome
aliases: Fibrous Dysplasia of Bone with Endocrinopathies

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Radiological Diagnostic Criteria for McCune-Albright Syndrome

criteria.description: Presence of polyostotic fibrous dysplasia confirmed by radiological and/or histological findings
Characteristic irregular 'coast of Maine' café-au-lait skin pigmentation
One or more hyperfunctioning endocrinopathies such as precocious puberty, hyperthyroidism, or growth hormone excess
Detection of somatic activating mutation in GNAS gene in affected tissues

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of polyostotic fibrous dysplasia plus at least one of either characteristic café-au-lait macules or hyperfunctioning endocrinopathy
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is clinical and radiological; genetic testing supports but is not mandatory.

pathognomonic.notes: Radiographically lytic and expansile bone lesions with ground-glass appearance
Hyperpigmented skin patches with jagged borders
searchTerms: coast of Maine shaped skin patches

pathognomonic.symptomName: Precocious puberty due to autonomous ovarian or testicular function
pathognomonic.notes: Most common endocrinopathy in affected children

common.symptomName: Bone pain localized to fibrous dysplasia lesions
common.notes: Often worsens with activity or fracture
searchTerms: bone pain at fibrous lesion sites

common.notes: Pathologic fractures due to weakened bone structure
Due to autonomous thyroid hormone production

common.symptomName: Growth hormone excess leading to acromegaly features
searchTerms: excess growth hormone causing enlarged features

occasional.notes: Due to fibrous dysplasia involvement of skull bones

searchTerms: excess cortisol causing weight gain and weakness

occasional.symptomName: Vision impairment due to optic nerve compression
searchTerms: vision problems from optic nerve pressure
blurred or lost sight due to nerve compression

occasional.symptomName: Hearing loss from temporal bone involvement
searchTerms: hearing loss from skull bone involvement
decreased hearing due to temporal bone disease
ear problems linked to bone lesions
heart muscle disease from hormone disorders
heart problems secondary to hormone imbalance

rare.symptomName: Hypophosphatemic rickets due to renal phosphate wasting
rare.notes: Associated with fibroblast growth factor 23 overproduction
searchTerms: rickets from low phosphate due to kidney loss

rare.symptomName: Neurological deficits from skull base involvement
searchTerms: neurological problems from skull base lesions
nerve deficits due to skull involvement
brain or nerve symptoms from skull disease

laboratory: Elevated serum calcium and phosphate abnormalities in some cases
Hormonal assays showing elevated sex steroids, thyroid hormones, or growth hormone
imaging: Radiographs showing ground-glass appearance of affected bones
CT/MRI demonstrating craniofacial fibrous dysplasia and soft tissue involvement
genetic: Somatic activating mutations in GNAS gene encoding the Gs alpha subunit
other: Histopathology showing fibrous tissue replacing normal bone trabeculae

distinguishingFeatures: Typically affects tibia and fibula only
No associated endocrinopathies or café-au-lait macules
Usually presents in infancy or early childhood
Malignant bone tumor with aggressive radiographic features
Absence of skin pigmentation and endocrinopathies
